changes: First Modwerk release for Digitakt I OS 1.54, on Core 2.1. SETTINGS > INPUT SENDS PRE takes IN L and IN R’s delay and reverb sends before their External Mixer LEV, so an input at LEV 0 goes fully wet to the effects.
Source-only export compiled in the pinned GCC 16.2 Docker toolchain; byte-identical to the package built with the author’s local GCC 16.2 and flashed for the hardware tests.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
